kaps_punt: Geleiers - elektrisiteit kan deur sekere materiale vloei en dit word geleiers genoem; die meeste metale, veral koper, gelei elektrisiteit. Nie-geleiers - sommige materiaal gelei nie elektrisiteit nie en word nie-geleiers genoem; die meeste nie-metale, soos plastiek, gelei nie elektrisiteit nie; identifisering waar elektriese nie-geleiers gebruik word soos in plastiek geisoleerde drade, rubber handskoene wat deur elektrisiens gebruik word, glas en keramiek isolators wat op kraglyne gebruik word

items.bewering: In baie drade, soos die draad van 'n lamp, lê blink koper binne en plastiek buite.
items.bron: Plastic as the common wire insulation (Wikipedia, Insulator (electricity): https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Insulator_(electricity)); copper as the dominant wiring conductor (conductivity chart and wiring summary via https://www.metalsupermarkets.co.uk/which-metals-conduct-electricity/). Volledige ondersoek, eerste rondte op hierdie konsep.

items.bewering: Die koper is daar omdat elektrisiteit maklik daardeur loop. Ons noem 'n materiaal wat elektrisiteit deurlaat 'n geleier.
items.bron: Copper at 100% IACS, second only to silver (https://viox.com/conductivity-vs-resistivity-iacs/; https://www.metalsupermarkets.co.uk/which-metals-conduct-electricity/).

items.bewering: Alle metale is geleiers, maar party gelei baie beter as ander.
items.bron: Universal claim checked: Universität Bayreuth, Didaktik der Chemie, conductivity experiment page, lists 'all metals' as conductors (https://daten.didaktikchemie.uni-bayreuth.de/experimente/exkursion/conductivity_electrical.htm). That conductivity varies widely among metals: IACS figures, copper 100%, aluminium about 61%, stainless steel a few percent (https://viox.com/conductivity-vs-resistivity-iacs/).

items.bewering: Baie drade in huise en toestelle is van koper omdat koper baie goed gelei.
items.bron: https://www.metalsupermarkets.co.uk/which-metals-conduct-electricity/ (copper used for wiring because it is the best conductor apart from much more expensive silver). Cost and ductility also count, but 'omdat koper baie goed gelei' is a true reason, not a false one.

items.bewering: Staal is ook 'n geleier, maar dit gelei baie swakker as koper.
items.bron: 304 stainless at about 1.1-1.5 MS/m against copper at 58 MS/m, i.e. a few percent of copper (https://viox.com/conductivity-vs-resistivity-iacs/). Carbon steel runs higher, at roughly a tenth of copper, so it is still far worse.

items.bewering: Die plastiek om die koper laat feitlik geen elektrisiteit deur nie. So 'n materiaal noem ons 'n nie-geleier.
items.bron: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Insulator_(electricity). 'Feitlik geen' is the correct hedge, because no insulator is a perfect one.

items.bewering: Die meeste nie-metale is nie-geleiers, soos plastiek, rubber, glas en keramiek.
items.bron: Quantifier 'die meeste' checked: glass, plastic, rubber and porcelain/ceramic are standard insulators (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Insulator_(electricity); porcelain and glass as line insulators, https://www.electricaleasy.com/2016/10/insulators-used-in-overhead-power-lines.html). 'Die meeste' rather than 'alle' is right: graphite and salty water are non-metallic and conduct.

items.bewering: Keramiek is die harde gebakte klei van teëls, borde en baie koppies.
items.bron: Ceramic is a hard material made from clay fired at high temperature; examples include porcelain, earthenware, brick and tile (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ceramic; https://www.dictionary.com/browse/Ceramic).

items.bewering: Water is ook 'n nie-metaal, maar kraanwater laat wel elektrisiteit deur.
items.bron: Tap water conducts because of dissolved ions (https://www.scienceabc.com/pure-sciences/do-you-think-that-water-conducts-electricity-if-you-do-then-youre-wrong). 'Nie-metaal' here is used in the lesson's own materials sense ('materiaal wat nie metaal is nie', the begrip block), the same sense in which plastic and wood are called non-metals. In that sense water is one. In chemistry's element sense water is a compound and not a non-metal, but that sense is not the one this lesson, or its CAPS bullet, uses. Recorded so a person can see the point was considered.

items.bewering: Geleiers: metaalskuifspelde, spykers, metaaldraad, staalwol en munte. Almal is van metaal.
items.bron: 'Almal' checked item by item. Paper clips, nails, wire and steel wool are steel or other metals. South African coins are metal (nickel-plated steel, bronze- or copper-plated steel, bimetal R5): https://dailyinvestor.com/finance/6023/new-coins-for-south-africa/ and https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Coins_of_the_South_African_rand. All metals conduct (Bayreuth page above).

items.bewering: Nie-geleiers: plastiek, glas, keramiek, karton, papier, hout, rubber en kryt. Almal is nie-metale.
items.bron: 'Almal' checked item by item. Plastic, glass, paper and rubber are insulators (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Insulator_(electricity)). Chalk and wood are insulators, according to Universität Bayreuth, Didaktik der Chemie (https://daten.didaktikchemie.uni-bayreuth.de/experimente/exkursion/conductivity_electrical.htm). Ceramic: see porcelain line insulators. None of the items is a metal. Wood, paper and card are qualified by the next list item.

items.bewering: Hout, papier en karton is net nie-geleiers wanneer hulle droog is. Nat hout laat elektrisiteit deur.
items.bron: NIOSH/CDC: dry wood ladders are nonconductors; trees and ropes can conduct depending on moisture content and surface contamination (https://stacks.cdc.gov/view/cdc/170136/cdc_170136_DS1.pdf; https://stacks.cdc.gov/view/cdc/228664/cdc_228664_DS1.pdf).

items.bewering: Kragdrade stoot elektrisiteit selfs deur hout wat droog lyk. Geen stok, nat of droog, is veilig by 'n kragdraad nie.
items.bron: Universal 'geen stok' checked. Ontario's Electrical Safety Authority, power-line myths and facts: even wood can conduct electricity (https://esasafe.com/safety/powerline-safety/myths-and-facts/). Fairfax County: all ladders, even wooden or fiberglass, can conduct, so keep 10 feet away (https://fairfaxva.gov/home/showpublisheddocument/14226/637082040570900000). Hydro-Quebec advice on long objects near lines (https://hydroquebec.com/safety/power-lines/activities-near-lines.html). ESB Networks: do not let anything you hold come near an overhead line (https://esbnetworks.ie/docs/default-source/publications/public-safety-advice.pdf). The Eskom material found (via Grocott's Mail, https://grocotts.ru.ac.za/2010/02/11/keep-away-from-low-hanging-power-lines/) treats every line as live and does not mention sticks specifically. The safety rule is correctly stated.

items.bewering: Vir die toets sit 'n mens die materiaal in 'n gaping in 'n eenvoudige stroombaan met 'n sel en 'n lampie. Brand die lampie, dan het die materiaal die stroombaan voltooi en is dit 'n geleier. Bly die lampie donker, dan laat die materiaal nie genoeg elektrisiteit deur om die lampie te laat brand nie.
items.bron: Conductivity-tester guidance: no light means a non-conductor or too little current, dim light a poor conductor, bright light a good one (Central San conductivity-meter build guide, https://www.centralsan.org/sites/main/files/file-attachments/final_-__conductivity_meter_how_to_build_guide_1.pdf). The lesson's careful wording ('nie genoeg ... om die lampie te laat brand nie') is correct: a dark lamp does not prove that no current flows.

items.bewering: Die drade raak net aan die buitekant van die materiaal. 'n Skuifspeld wat met 'n laag plastiek of verf bedek is, kan die lampie donker hou. Die metaal binne die laag is tog 'n geleier.
items.bron: Universität Bayreuth, Didaktik der Chemie: iron conducts but its rust (a surface layer) does not, so a surface coating decides the test result (https://daten.didaktikchemie.uni-bayreuth.de/experimente/exkursion/conductivity_electrical.htm). Plastic as an insulating coating: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Insulator_(electricity).

items.bewering: Kraanwater en badwater laat elektrisiteit deur en so ook damwater en sweet. Daar is stowwe in die water opgelos, en hulle laat die elektrisiteit deur.
items.bron: Dissolved minerals and salts form ions that carry the current; pure water is a poor conductor (https://www.scienceabc.com/pure-sciences/do-you-think-that-water-conducts-electricity-if-you-do-then-youre-wrong). Sweat is salty, and wet skin conducts far better (OSHA/NIOSH figures below).

items.bewering: Jou lyf gelei ook, en nat vel laat elektrisiteit baie makliker deur as droë vel.
items.bron: OSHA Construction eTool / NIOSH figures (UAH copy): dry skin up to about 100 000 ohm, wet or broken skin about 1 000 ohm (https://www.uah.edu/images/administrative/facilities/oehs/how_electrical_current_affects_the_human_body.pdf; https://ehsdailyadvisor.com/2009/08/shocking-news-about-electrical-emergencies).

items.bewering: Tog kan die lampie by kraanwater of 'n vinger donker bly of net flou gloei. Hulle gelei baie swakker as metaal en 'n sel stoot te swak om genoeg elektrisiteit daardeur te stuur.
items.bron: The conductivity-tester guidance (Central San, above) treats tap water as a weak conductor that gives a dim or no light. Ohm's law with the OSHA/NIOSH skin figures: a 1.5 V cell across tens of thousands of ohms gives microamps, far below what a torch bulb needs. The 'kan ... of' form is true. Note for a person, not a defect: with a filament bulb a finger will in practice always leave it dark, and only an LED might glow faintly, so 'flou gloei' really applies to tap water.

items.bewering: 'n Muursok stoot baie harder as 'n sel. Dit kan genoeg elektrisiteit deur nat vel en jou lyf stuur om jou erg te beseer.
items.bron: South African mains is nominally 230 V, 50 Hz (https://www.worldstandards.eu/electricity/plug-voltage-by-country/south-africa/; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/SANS_164), against 1.5 V for a cell. OSHA/NIOSH: at 120 V and 1 000 ohm (wet skin) the current is about 120 mA, enough to cause ventricular fibrillation (UAH copy above), so at 230 V even more.

items.bewering: 'n Donker lampie beteken dus nie dat 'n materiaal naby 'n sok veilig is nie.
items.bron: This follows from the two items above (weak conductors stay dark at 1.5 V and are dangerous at 230 V). It is consistent with the OSHA/NIOSH Ohm's-law illustration (UAH copy).

items.bewering: 'n Sel stoot / 'n muursok stoot baie harder / kragdrade stoot elektrisiteit (die 'stoot'-beeld vir spanning, deur die les).
items.bron: Mapping checked. Voltage as a push that drives current through a resistance. If a learner reasons further from it, a harder push sends more current through the same material, which is Ohm's law and matches the OSHA/NIOSH 100 000 ohm against 1 000 ohm illustration (UAH copy above). It also explains why a material that keeps a lamp dark at 1.5 V can be dangerous at 230 V or near a power line. The picture does not suggest that the cell itself supplies the moving charge or that electricity gets used up. No point found where it misleads at Grade 6.

items.bewering: Die koper binne die draad is die geleier wat die elektrisiteit na die lamp dra. Die plastiek buite is 'n nie-geleier. Dit hou die elektrisiteit weg van die hand wat die draad vashou. Ons sê so 'n draad is geïsoleer.
items.bron: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Insulator_(electricity) (plastic as wire insulation for homes and vehicles).

items.bewering: Die plastiek beskerm egter nie meer nie as dit gebars of stukkend is. 'n Nat draad of prop is ook nie veilig nie. Water kan deur 'n kraak by die koper kom.
items.bron: CCOHS inspection guidance: check for damaged wires and plugs and for wet plugs, and never use faulty equipment (https://ccohs.gc.ca/teach_tools/phys_hazards/electrical.html). OSHA Academy: bared conductors create a shock risk, and water on a connector lets current leak to anyone touching it (https://oshacademy.com/courses/training/809-focus-four-electrocution-hazards/809-1-6.php). NIOSH case of a fatal shock through a worn cord (https://stacks.cdc.gov/view/cdc/164366).

items.bewering: Elektrisiëns dra spesiale rubberhandskoene wat vir elektriese werk gemaak en getoets is. Die rubber keer dat elektrisiteit deur hulle hande en lyf loop.
items.bron: IEC 60903: electrical insulating rubber gloves in classes 00-4, each proof-tested at a stated voltage (e.g. class 00 at 2 500 V, rated 500 V) to protect the worker against electric shock (https://www.powerandcables.com/iec60903-gloves/; CATU class 00 datasheet, https://www.powerandcables.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/06/CATU-CG-05-Class-00-Electrical-Insulating-Rubber-Gloves-IEC-60903-1.pdf).

items.bewering: 'n Gewone kombuishandskoen is nie vir hierdie werk gemaak nie.
items.bron: The IEC 60903 sources above: protection comes from a rated, tested class with a minimum thickness and proof-test voltage, which household gloves do not carry.

items.bewering: Die drade van baie kraglyne is kaal metaal sonder plastiek om.
items.bron: Bare overhead conductors, usually aluminium or steel-reinforced aluminium, with air as the insulation medium (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Overhead_power_line; https://www.electricaleasy.com/2016/10/insulators-used-in-overhead-power-lines.html).

items.bewering: Hulle hang aan isolators waarvan baie van glas of keramiek is. Die isolator hou die draad aan die paal of mas vas. Dit keer dat die elektrisiteit deur die paal of mas na die grond loop.
items.bron: Insulators are mostly porcelain or toughened glass, with polymer types increasingly used, which is why 'baie' is right and not 'alle'. Without insulation from the poles or towers, current would flow through them to the ground (https://www.electricaleasy.com/2016/10/insulators-used-in-overhead-power-lines.html; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Overhead_power_line).

items.bewering: geleier: 'n Materiaal wat elektrisiteit deurlaat, soos koper of staal.
items.bron: Copper and steel both conduct (https://viox.com/conductivity-vs-resistivity-iacs/; Bayreuth page).

items.bewering: nie-geleier: 'n Materiaal wat feitlik geen elektrisiteit deurlaat nie, soos plastiek of rubber.
items.bron: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Insulator_(electricity).

items.bewering: isolator: 'n Stuk nie-geleier wat keer dat elektrisiteit loop waar dit nie moet nie.
items.bron: Line insulators prevent current flowing to the support and the ground (https://www.electricaleasy.com/2016/10/insulators-used-in-overhead-power-lines.html). The general sense of the word is in https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Insulator_(electricity).

items.bewering: nie-metaal: Materiaal wat nie metaal is nie, soos kryt, klip, hout of plastiek.
items.bron: None of the examples is a metal. Chalk, rock and wood are listed as insulators by Universität Bayreuth (https://daten.didaktikchemie.uni-bayreuth.de/experimente/exkursion/conductivity_electrical.htm). The definition is the materials sense of the word, not chemistry's element sense (see the water item). That is the sense the CAPS bullet itself uses ('die meeste nie-metale, soos plastiek').

items.bewering: keramiek: Harde materiaal van klei wat in 'n baie warm oond gebak is.
items.bron: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ceramic; https://www.dictionary.com/browse/Ceramic. Engineering ceramics need not contain clay, but the household and porcelain-insulator sense is fired clay, and the definition is correct for that sense.

items.bewering: elektrisiën: Iemand wie se werk dit is om elektriese drade aan te lê en reg te maak.
items.bron: No Afrikaans dictionary entry was found online. The Dutch ANW defines 'elektricien' as someone whose trade is installing, maintaining and repairing electrical installations (via https://www.encyclo.nl/begrip/elektrici%C3%ABn). The cognate meaning is the same.

items.bewering: geïsoleer: Toegedraai in 'n nie-geleier, soos 'n koperdraad met plastiek om.
items.bron: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Insulator_(electricity) (insulated wire is a conductor covered in plastic).

opsomming: Every claim in all fourteen blocks was checked and confirmed, including five quantifier claims ('alle', 'die meeste', twice 'almal', 'geen stok') and the 'stoot' picture for voltage. Two points worth a person's glance but not defects: 'water is ook 'n nie-metaal' is true only in the lesson's own materials sense, the same sense CAPS uses for plastic, and a finger in a cell-and-bulb circuit will in practice never make the bulb glow even faintly.
